sourceNotes.rawContent: Celebrate love and modern style with our exquisite Heart Lariat Necklace. Featuring a delicate open-heart centerpiece and a graceful solid-heart drop, this Y-style necklace is designed to elongate your neckline with effortless elegance. A perfect fashion statement for date nights and special occasions, this piece maintains its golden radiance best when kept away from water and perfumes. We recommend storing it in a dry, soft pouch after your day of shine to keep it looking beautiful.
